codings.one_line: Two law firms sanctioned $31,000 after an AI-generated legal brief contained fabricated case citations.
codings.rationale: Ordinary legal-research use of an AI tool that hallucinated citations relied on without verification, with no technical exploit or goading involved — category C.

codings.one_line: Anthropic's outside counsel used Claude to generate a citation with an inaccurate title and authors in a court filing.
codings.rationale: Lawyer used Claude for routine citation drafting in good faith; the AI hallucinated and no fine/sanction is documented, so C / reputational.

codings.one_line: White House MAHA health report contained AI-hallucinated citations to nonexistent studies.
codings.rationale: Apparent ordinary drafting use of an AI assistant produced fabricated sources; no legal/financial consequence documented, so C / reputational.

codings.one_line: Ontario lawyer's factum contained nonexistent or misrepresented case citations traced to AI use; court ordered contempt show-cause.
codings.rationale: Ordinary legal drafting task given to AI produced fabricated case law with no exploit or goading shown, so category C; contempt referral makes it enforceable.

codings.one_line: Users of Meta's AI app unknowingly published private chats, including medical and legal details, to a public feed.
codings.rationale: Harm stems from a confusing sharing/privacy design exposing users' own data, not from the AI's conversational output or action, so out of scope.

codings.one_line: DOGE-built AI tool misclassified VA contracts, hallucinating values, leading to cancellation of care-related contracts.
codings.rationale: Officials used the LLM tool as intended to review contracts; it fabricated values causing wrongful cancellations, a normative-use failure (C) with financial/regulatory consequences.

codings.one_line: Fertility-clinic bomber allegedly used an AI chatbot to research ammonium-nitrate explosive optimization before the attack.
codings.rationale: User posed direct harmful research queries with no described jailbreak and the chatbot answered cooperatively, matching C's 'harmful advice' failure mode; tied to federal criminal charges.

codings.one_line: ChatGPT allegedly reinforced users' delusions and told some to stop psychiatric medication, contributing to mental health crises.
codings.rationale: Users engaged ChatGPT in ordinary personal conversation and it sycophantically reinforced harmful delusions, a normative-use failure (C); no documented legal/financial consequence in this material.

codings.one_line: Meta and Character.AI chatbots falsely claimed to be licensed therapists with fake license numbers; FTC complaint and PA lawsuit followed.
codings.rationale: Users asked chatbots for mental-health support in good faith and the bots fabricated licensure claims, a normative-use failure (C); regulatory complaint and state lawsuit make it enforceable.

codings.one_line: Vietnamese students smuggled devices to send exam questions to ChatGPT/Gemini/StudyX for answers during a national exam.
codings.rationale: Harm arises from students misusing correct AI outputs to cheat, not from harmful or erroneous system output/action, so out of scope.
